hints: Put the longest side in the role of c before comparing squares.

constraints: a^2 + b^2 > c^2 means acute, < c^2 means obtuse
hints: Identify the longest side before forming the sum of the other two squared lengths.
Compare that sum with the square of the longest side.
A greater sum means the largest angle is less than a quarter-turn; a smaller sum means it exceeds a quarter-turn; equality means a quarter-turn. Match that angle to its triangle classification.
